propositions: The llm.headers knob and its grammar are undocumented in the primary LLM configuration files, preventing operator discovery and increasing risk of committed credentials.

The three header resolution layers, ${env:...} and ${run:...} value grammar with closed vocabulary, and rejected header names must be documented in docs/config.md for parity with other LLM configuration.
Gateway-observability recipes showing multiple vendors and the nginx underscore-stripping caveat must be added to docs/llm-framework.md to guide safe gateway configuration.

Security guidance must explicitly state that values reference environment variables to avoid committed credentials, authentication header names are rejected because caller headers displace real credentials, and values are never recorded.
The Bedrock path limitation where pydantic-ai headers do not reach must be documented so operators do not discover it empirically.
The provenance record field header_names carries header names only, never values, and must be documented as such.
